name: Itouda Naito
source:
Cram school instructor. He became a teacher with the intention of eating his students.

He claims to be a "sadist" and thinks that it will attract some students to still come to him. He is smart, but his ideas are shallow.

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_030/character.html]official site[/url]]
